pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular, jagged dark brown polygons with high-frequency edge serration and stellate projections. Individual patches on the mid-flank exhibit starburst-like extensions rather than smooth curvilinear boundaries.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light cream-colored interstitial pathways forming a high-connectivity topological graph. Intersection nodes are predominantly tri-radial and quadri-radial. Pathway thickness is non-uniform, narrowing at the junction of jagged patch extensions.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Visible mane along the dorsal neck line displays a low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette consisting of short, stiff hair bundles against the foliage background.

other_distinctive_markers: Significant occlusion of the primary subject's lower ventral and anterior limb regions by a juvenile conspecific in the foreground.
